text:
leah-sales: Quick sync on Oxbridge Med POC — kickoff Tues. They want a 1-week hosted trial but may push PHI. Core asks: SSO (SAML both IdP/SP), SCIM group + delta sync, RBAC per hospital + delegated admin, and domain proofing. Any blockers?

devon-se: do they require IdP-initiated only or want SP-init too?

leah-sales: both. Okta + AzureAD on their side.

samir-security: got their security questionnaire. Main asks: SOC2, DPA with PHI addendum, audit log retention (they want 1 year for SCIM/provisioning), and tenant isolation guarantees. Can we provide a DPA for a short hosted POC?

maria-ps: For a hosted POC we can create a staging tenant and issue credits. SCIM supports delta patching; default rate limit is 10 req/s but we can bump temporarily for the POC window. If they need constant high-throughput provisioning we recommend Dedicated.

devon-se: SCIM specifics: we implement SCIM 2.0 with PATCH for membership, supports bulk +/- pagination. Default throttle 10req/s; ops can raise to 50req/s for <=2 weeks. For >50k users recommend Dedicated/Private.

leah-sales: their rough numbers: ~12k users, ~3k groups. They also asked for delegated admin so each hospital IT team can manage staff.

maria-ps: Delegated admin UI is not GA on hosted. Options: 1) temporary managed delegation via role scoping we can configure for POC 2) Dedicated or Private for stronger isolation and native delegated admin. Delegation as a product feature is an enterprise add-on.

samir-security: Domain verification flow: DNS TXT record (preferred) or email-based proof. For PHI: hosted offers logical separation + encryption at rest/in transit, but no customer-dedicated networking. Recommend Private (VPC) or on-prem for regulated PHI. If they insist on hosted with PHI we need signed PHI addendum upfront.

leah-sales: pricing Qs: will POC credits cover delegated admin or Private? If not, how much approx for a 2-week Private eval?

maria-ps: POC credits cover hosted infra only. Private eval requires setup fee and typical provisioning 4-6 weeks; cost estimate depends on size but we can provide a draft ballpark. Delegated admin feature requires enterprise contract.

devon-se: Sharing a SAML mapping snippet for their IdP team:
```
SAML -> NameID: email
Attributes: email, givenName, familyName, groups, role
ACS: https://redwood.prod/saml/acs/<tenant>
Support: SP-Init=true, IdP-Init=true
```

leah-sales: looping in amy-legal to expedite DPA/PHI addendum. Also need ops to seed users for POC — can ops bump SCIM rate?

amy-legal: I'll push our standard DPA and a PHI addendum template. If they require Private for POC we need SOW + signatures; I can draft by EOD.

ops-bot: Provisioning ticket created: #PR-4521 — created staging tenant oxbridge-staging, SCIM rate bumped to 50 req/s for 14 days, seeding pending.

devon-se: Action items: 1) devon: validate SCIM pagination/perf for 12k users + provide sample import script. 2) maria: prepare RBAC role templates and delegated admin options doc. 3) sales + maria: confirm POC credits and Private eval cost ballpark. 4) amy: DPA + PHI addendum draft. 5) samir: sample DNS TXT for domain proofing and tenant isolation language.

leah-sales: I'll schedule kickoff and share the security questionnaire link to Oxbridge: https://redwood.ai/sec/q/oxbridge. Tagging @samir-security for any showstoppers.

samir-security: quick red flag: if they insist on PHI on hosted without signed addendum that's a blocker. Otherwise looks ok pending DPA.

maria-ps: I'll upload the RBAC templates and a short comparison table (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) to the POC folder.

leah-sales: thanks team — report back after kickoff. :thumbsup:
